title: 第275章 危机警报
slug: 德黑兰杂货铺我的情报明码标价
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

巴扎尔甘，城北郊外的园区内。

早上8点。

张剑打着哈欠推开卫生间的门，拧开水龙头，捧起凉水洗了把脸。

昨天睡的有点迟，这会儿脑子还有点昏沉。

刚拿起牙刷挤上牙膏，门外就传来一阵急促的敲门声。

“进。”

张剑含糊不清地喊了一声。

法哈德推门大步走进来，手里拿着平板电脑，脸上满是遮掩不住的喜色。

“老板，好消息！”

张剑一边刷牙，一边转头看他。

“美军凌晨发起的‘自由计划’行动，被革命卫队全部防住了！”

法哈德走到洗手台边，语速极快。

“南部防空部队在格什姆岛上空，成功击伤了一架美军的EA-18G电子战机！”

“可惜没能直接击落，让它带伤逃回了波斯湾。”

法哈德语气里带着几分惋惜，但更多的是兴奋。

“另外，阿布穆萨岛那边也发生了小规模交火。”

“守军提前布防，击退了一批试图趁乱摸上岛搞破坏的武装分子。”

“霍尔木兹海峡方向，四艘妄图潜入排雷的复仇者级扫雷舰，也被我们的岸防部队用火控雷达锁定，直接逼退了。”

他一口气把情况汇报完，整个人到现在还没有冷静下来。

作为前情报部的高级特工，他太清楚这些战果背后的分量了。

如果没有自家老板提前提供的那些精准情报。

昨晚的伊朗南部沿海，绝对不会好受。

雷达站被炸，防空系统瘫痪，甚至可能连阿布穆萨岛这样的战略要地都会遭到重创。

但现在，不仅防住了，还让老美吃了个闷亏。

张剑吐掉嘴里的沫子，漱了漱口。

拿过旁边的毛巾擦了一把脸，伸手去摸放在洗手台上的手机。

解锁屏幕，点开国际新闻频道。

屏幕上，铺天盖地全是关于昨晚波斯湾冲突的报道。

头条赫然是伊朗军方发言人的视频。

视频里，发言人意气风发，详细通报了昨晚击退美军机群的战果，甚至还展示了雷达捕捉到的部分航迹图。

张剑往下滑了滑屏幕。

紧跟着的，就是白宫和五角大楼的联合新闻发布会。

点开视频。

画面中，五角大楼的发言人西装革履，直接驳斥伊朗的发言。

“关于伊朗方面宣称击伤我方EA-18G战机的言论，纯属无稽之谈。”

“昨晚，我方航母编队只是在国际空域进行了一次例行的突防战术训练。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Bazargan, in the park on the northern outskirts of the city.

8am.

Zhang Jian yawned and pushed open the bathroom door, turned on the faucet, and washed his face with cold water.

I slept a little late yesterday, and my mind is still a little drowsy now.

As soon as I picked up my toothbrush and put some toothpaste on it, there was a rapid knock on the door.

"Come in."

Zhang Jian shouted vaguely.

Fahad pushed open the door and strode in, holding a tablet in his hand and his face full of unconcealable joy.

"Boss, good news!"

Zhang Jian turned to look at him while brushing his teeth.

"The 'Freedom Plan' operation launched by the US military in the early morning was completely blocked by the Revolutionary Guards!"

Farhad walked to the sink and spoke very fast.

"The southern air defense force successfully damaged a US military EA-18G electronic warfare aircraft over Qeshm Island!"

"It's a pity that it couldn't be shot down directly, and it escaped back to the Persian Gulf with injuries."

There was a bit of regret in Farhad's tone, but more of excitement.

"In addition, there was also a small-scale exchange of fire on the Abu Musa Island side."

"The defenders deployed their defenses in advance and repelled a group of militants who tried to take advantage of the chaos to reach the island and cause damage."

"In the direction of the Strait of Hormuz, four Avengers-class minesweepers that attempted to sneak in to clear mines were also locked by our coastal defense forces using fire control radars and were forced back."

He reported the situation in one breath, and he still hasn't calmed down yet.

As a former senior agent of the Intelligence Department, he is very aware of the weight behind these results.

Without the accurate information provided by my boss in advance.

Last night on the southern coast of Iran was definitely not going to be easy.

The radar station is bombed, the air defense system is paralyzed, and even strategic locations such as Abu Musa Island may be hit hard.

But now, not only did they prevent it, but they also caused the United States to suffer a heavy loss.

Zhang Jian spit out the foam in his mouth and rinsed his mouth.

He took the towel next to him and wiped his face, then reached out to touch the mobile phone on the sink.

Unlock the screen and click on the international news channel.

On the screen, reports about the conflict in the Persian Gulf last night were overwhelming.

The headline was a video of an Iranian military spokesman.

In the video, the spokesperson was high-spirited and reported in detail the results of repelling the US military fleet last night, and even showed part of the flight path map captured by the radar.

Zhang Jian slid down the screen.

What followed was a joint press conference between the White House and the Pentagon.

Click on the video.

In the picture, the Pentagon spokesman was wearing a suit and leather shoes and directly refuted Iran's statement.

"Iran's claim that it damaged our EA-18G fighter jet is pure nonsense."

"Last night, our aircraft carrier formation only conducted a routine penetration tactics training in international airspace."
